questions.name: Loan history · lifetime
questions.description: Lifetime signed interest received / original loan principal. Gross interest before expenses. <100% red; 100–200% inclusive orange; >200% green. Invalid/nonpositive original principal gives no percentage/color. Ignores activity dates.

native.query:
WITH clock AS (SELECT public.olap_reporting_date() today), chosen AS (SELECT * FROM public.reporting_borrower_directory_v1 WHERE borrower_id= [[{{borrower_id}} --]] '__select_borrower__'
) SELECT CASE WHEN k."Row ID" IS NULL THEN 'Loan key unavailable' ELSE coalesce(c.borrower_name,'Unknown borrower')||'-'||to_char(k."Principal Amount"::numeric,'FM999,999,999,990.00')||'-'||to_char(k."Loan Date",'DD/MM')||'-'||coalesce(to_char(k."Effective Daily Interest Rate"::numeric*100,'FM999990.00')||'%','Unavailable') END AS "Loan Key",l.loan_date AS "Loan date",l.loan_type AS "Loan type",l.loan_status AS "Status",l.original_principal AS "Original principal ฿",l.outstanding_principal AS "Current principal ฿",l.principal_received AS "Principal received ฿",l.interest_received AS "Interest received ฿",CASE WHEN l.original_principal>0 THEN l.interest_received/l.original_principal END AS "Profit / original principal",l.close_date AS "Close date",l.defaulted AS "Defaulted",l.default_loss AS "Recorded loss ฿" FROM chosen c JOIN public.reporting_borrower_loan_facts_v1 l USING(borrower_id) LEFT JOIN public.olap_loans_analytics k ON k."Row ID"=l.loan_id ORDER BY l.is_active DESC,l.loan_date DESC,l.loan_id

questions.name: Payments · selected payment dates
questions.description: Original payment receipts, one row per Payments record, including unposted states. All payment details included by owner request. Amount received and posted amount are separate; repayments below are allocation rows. Reference IDs are resolved to readable names/Loan Keys.
